g.text: Client C: H = 30, L = 40%. All five outer fits computed successfully; three abstained from automatic execution.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Fit 2 has inner-equivalent beta values; fit 4 changes which inner fits are admitted. These are not the same failure.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: At selected beta = .05, the unrounded refit allowance is 4.8; minima 6 and 7 still exceed it. Rounding alone is insufficient.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: A same-name price can change target, training fan and endogenous state. Count ledgers do not identify separate causal effects.
